# Weekly Scope Gating Skill

## When to use

- At the start of every task, before selecting other skills

## Rule

Only implement what the current week explicitly requires.

## Workflow

1. Read `.github/weekly-specifications/week-N.md` for the active week.
2. Map each requirement to the minimum skill subset from
   `.github/copilot-instructions.md`.
3. Use the reference repo (https://github.com/ISS-Security/tyto2026-app) as an
   architectural guide — do not exceed specified scope.
4. Defer out-of-scope work as roadmap notes only.
5. Typical preflight for app work:
   - feature-branch-workflow
   - tdd-mastery
   - controller-service-view
   - api-integration
   - session-authentication (if auth touched)
